title: Anaconda
passNotice: Pass phase — choose {{count}} card(s) to pass left.
setNotice: Set phase — keep your best 5 cards (discard 2).
rollNotice: Roll phase — {{revealed}}/5 revealed. Call, raise, or fold.

hint.medium_hand: Decent hand — call to see more

tutorial.info: This shows the round number, pot, ante, current bet, and each player's chips and status. Anaconda (Pass the Trash) is a poker pot game: you are dealt 7 cards, pass 3 then 2 then 1 to the left, keep your best 5, then reveal them one at a time with a betting round between reveals.
tutorial.hand: Your cards. During the Pass phase tap cards to pass left; during the Set phase tap exactly 5 cards to keep. During the Roll they are revealed one at a time.
tutorial.actions: Pass or Keep the selected cards, then during the Roll choose Call/Check, Raise, or Fold. The best 5-card poker hand still in the round wins the pot.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset the game and start over.
